Market today: Chip sector has a bullish signal from Nvidia, but broader market sentiment is mixed with warnings of a potential growth stock bubble and economic drag from high diesel prices. This creates a push-pull for your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.76%) and SPAL (-27.75%) are your biggest concerns, both leveraged and marked "SELL." Margin amplifies these deep drawdowns. SMH (-11.78%) and QQQI (-4.14%) also need attention, marked "TRIM."

Watch: Keep a close eye on any signs of a growth stock pullback, given the "market bubble" warning. Also, watch for follow-through on Nvidia's bullish chip forecast.

Bottom line: With leveraged positions and margin, risk management on your deeply red holdings is paramount in this uncertain market.
plays: SOXL: Your -54.76% loss on this leveraged ETF is critical. Set a hard stop below current price (115.14) to protect capital.
SPAL: This leveraged ETF is down -27.75%. Respect its stop at 21.38 to limit further losses.
MRVL: Consider a new buy at 240.95-240.71 with a stop at 240.09, aligning with bullish chip news.
